name: 📝 Linter

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  frontend:
    name: Frontend
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: yarn

      - name: Install Dependencies and Lint Repo
        run: |
          yarn install --frozen-lockfile
          yarn typecheck
          yarn check-format

  backend:
    name: Backend Formatting
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Rust Stable
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: clippy

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        name: Cache Rust Build
        with:
          shared-key: tauri-build-ubuntu-latest
          workspaces: src-tauri

      - name: Check Rust formatting
        run: |
          cd src-tauri/
          cargo fmt --all --check

  backend-linter:
    name: Backend Linter
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: yarn

      - name: Install Linux Dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libgtk-3-dev webkit2gtk-4.0 libappindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf

      - name: Install NPM Dependencies
        run: |
          yarn install --frozen-lockfile
          yarn build

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        name: Cache Rust Build
        with:
          shared-key: tauri-build-${{ matrix.platform }}
          workspaces: src-tauri

      - uses: actions-rs/clippy-check@v1
        name: Rust Linting - Clippy
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          args: --all-features --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
